# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Haoming Luo and AgentFEM contributors
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Serial SI displacement-controlled hyperelastic patch and accepted path."""
from pathlib import Path
from mpi4py import MPI
from agentfem import constitutive, fields, mechanics, mesh, models, project, results, steps, studies, units


def main():
    run = project.current_run(project_root=Path(__file__).parent)
    domain = mesh.cuboid((0., 0., 0.), (1., 1., 1.), (2, 1, 1), comm=MPI.COMM_SELF,
        cell_type="hexahedron")
    model = models.create(mesh=domain, study=studies.static_solid(dimension=3, nonlinear=True), units=units.si())
    u = model.field(fields.displacement(domain))
    model.material(constitutive.neo_hookean(young=1e6, poisson=.3))
    for component, axis in enumerate(("x", "y", "z")):
        model.fix(u, on=mesh.face(domain, axis=axis, value=0., tag=component+1), component=component)
    loaded = mesh.face(domain, axis="x", value=1., tag=4, name="displaced_end")
    model.fix(u, on=loaded, component=0, value=.1)
    output = results.OutputPlan(directory=run.output_directory,
        field=results.field_output("U", "S", every=1, configuration="reference"), basename="fields",
        write_manifest=False)  # RunContext publishes once, after curve attachment.
    step = model.step(target=u, incrementation=steps.fixed(4), output=output, progress=False)
    result = step.solve_result()
    path = mechanics.displacement_controlled_response(model, step, on=loaded, component=0, monitor_component=0)
    result.add_history("loaded_end_reaction", path["displacement"], path["reaction"], unit="N",
        abscissa_name="mean_loaded_end_displacement", abscissa_unit="m",
        description="Loaded support-on-body +x reaction at retained accepted stations; displacement is an area mean.")
    result.add_history("load_factor", path["displacement"], path["load_factor"], unit="1",
        abscissa_name="mean_loaded_end_displacement", abscissa_unit="m")
    result.verify(required_histories=("loaded_end_reaction", "load_factor"))
    run.publish(result)
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Haoming Luo and AgentFEM contributors
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

"""Small implicit structural-dynamics AgentFEM project."""

import os
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from mpi4py import MPI

from agentfem import constitutive, fields, mesh, models, project, results, studies, units


def main():
    run = project.current_run(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    study = studies.dynamic_solid(
        dimension=2,
        assumption="plane_stress",
        method="newmark",
        name="beam_dynamics",
    )
    domain = mesh.rectangle(
        (0.0, 0.0),
        (1.0, 0.2),
        (2, 1),
        comm=MPI.COMM_WORLD,
        cell_type="triangle",
    )
    model = models.create(study=study, mesh=domain, name="dynamic_beam", units=units.si())
    displacement = model.field(fields.displacement(domain))
    model.material(
        constitutive.isotropic_elastic(
            young=2.0e9,
            poisson=0.3,
            density=1000.0,
        )
    )
    left = mesh.boundary(domain, lambda x: np.isclose(x[0], 0.0), name="left", tag=1)
    right = mesh.boundary(domain, lambda x: np.isclose(x[0], 1.0), name="right", tag=2)
    model.clamp(displacement, on=left)
    model.traction((0.0, -1.0e4), on=right)

    step = model.step(
        target=displacement,
        dt=1.0e-4,
        steps=6,
        save_every=3,
        print_every=1,
        name="newmark_response",
        output=run.artifact("dynamics.xdmf"),
    )
    simulation = step.solve_result(
        history=(
            results.probe_history(
                "tip_U2",
                at=(1.0, 0.1),
                component=1,
                unit="m",
            ),
        ),
    )
    simulation.add_dof_statistics(
        step.state.u,
        prefix="final_displacement",
        unit="m",
    )
    run.publish(simulation, comm=MPI.COMM_WORLD)
    if MPI.COMM_WORLD.rank == 0:
        if not os.environ.get("AGENTFEM_CLI_MANAGED"):
            print(simulation.format())
            print(f"Result manifest: {run.manifest_path}")
    return simulation


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Haoming Luo and AgentFEM contributors
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""SI 3D cantilever: fields, a spatial point and the fixed-end reaction."""
from pathlib import Path
from mpi4py import MPI
from agentfem import constitutive, fields, mesh, models, project, results, studies, units


def main():
    run = project.current_run(project_root=Path(__file__).parent)
    domain = mesh.cuboid((0., 0., 0.), (1., .2, .2), (6, 2, 2), comm=MPI.COMM_WORLD)
    study = studies.static_solid(dimension=3)
    model = models.create(mesh=domain, study=study, units=units.si())
    u = model.field(fields.displacement(domain, degree=2))
    material = constitutive.isotropic_elastic(young=210e9, poisson=.3, density=7800.)
    model.material(material)
    fixed = mesh.face(domain, axis="x", value=0., tag=1, name="fixed")
    loaded = mesh.face(domain, axis="x", value=1., tag=2, name="loaded")
    model.clamp(u, on=fixed)
    model.traction((0., -1e6, 0.), on=loaded)
    step = model.step(target=u)
    result = step.solve_result(field_variables=("S",))
    result.add_quantity("tip_U2", results.probe(u, at=(1., .1, .1))[1], unit="m",
        description="Interpolated displacement at the specified reference point.")
    result.add_quantity("fixed_reaction", results.reaction_resultant(step, on=fixed), unit="N",
        description="Support-on-body force at the fixed end, global xyz components.")
    results.complete_result(step, result, output=run.artifact("fields.xdmf"), strict_output=True)
    result.verify(required_quantities=("tip_U2", "fixed_reaction"), required_artifacts=("fields_xdmf", "fields_hdf5"))
    run.publish(result, comm=MPI.COMM_WORLD)
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
